normalization.scope: Only holes entirely covered by the intended primitive union and allowed domain; no support admission.
normalization.arithmetic: Fraction of stored IEEE coordinates; exact convex partition by all primitive boundary lines
normalization.closure_argument: Positive convex cells partition the complete hole. Membership is constant on each cell interior; the finite primitive union is closed, so it also contains all cell boundaries.
